name: Hisaishi
source:
Hisaishi was a family lawyer of [url=/c10778]Mizuho[/url]'s grandfather Mitsuhisa. He was presented Mitsuhisa's surprising will to Mizuho along with [url=/c10796]Mariya[/url].
